info.title: Tasker REST API
info.description: Tasker REST API for managing personal todos, categories and comments.

get.description: Get the authenticated user’s todos with filtering, sorting and pagination.

post.description: Create a todo for the authenticated user.

get.description: Get task counts by status and overdue count for the authenticated user.
Get a todo and its populated relationships by ID.

patch.description: Partially update a todo owned by the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete a todo owned by the authenticated user.

204.description: Todo deleted successfully. No response body.

post.summary: Add a comment to a todo
post.description: Add a comment to a todo owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Get comments belonging to a todo owned by the authenticated user.
Get the authenticated user’s categories with search, sorting and pagination.

post.description: Create a category for the authenticated user.

get.description: Get a category owned by the authenticated user.

patch.description: Partially update a category owned by the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete a category owned by the authenticated user.

204.description: Category deleted successfully. No response body.

patch.description: Update a comment owned by the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete a comment owned by the authenticated user.

204.description: Comment deleted successfully. No response body.
